releaseNotes: 🚀 Official Production Release (V1.0.4 - Build 67)
🔐 Listen Together Firebase Auth & Room Sync Fix: Restored production Firebase project config and hardened guest join/re-join handling under strict Firestore security rules.
🎵 True Dual-Player Seamless Playback: Symmetric Active & Secondary audio slots eliminate tail replays, audio gaps, and stalls during track transitions.
⚡ Early ~10s Silent Preloading: Next track stream & decoder prepare silently at 0% volume around 10 seconds into playback without interrupting the current song.
♾️ Zero-Overlap Gapless Playback (0s) & Equal-Power Crossfade: Instantaneous gapless transitions or cos/sin overlap preserving full 10-band EQ & Bass Boost.
🛡️ Resilient Controls & Recovery: Pause/resume mid-crossfade pauses both players cleanly, isolated preload errors never stop active music, and shuffle reorders upcoming queue items.
